q: A Hermitian positive semidefinite (PSD) matrix A satisfies x*Ax ≥ 0 for all x. It is PSD if and only if:
opts: All principal submatrices have non-negative determinant
exp: PSD ↔ all eigenvalues ≥ 0 ↔ A = B*B for some matrix B ↔ all leading principal minors ≥ 0 (Sylvester's criterion for PSD). Note: all eigenvalues ≥ 0 is the correct characterization; checking all principal minors (not just leading ones) may be needed for PSD vs PD.
